title: Path-hard machine transition function
statement: For natural numbers $a,b,f$ and a Boolean mode, define a transition function assigning a register-machine instruction to every label of the machine. Its instructions implement input-length measurement, scanning and decoding the input, parameter and width calculations, and the subsequent dispatch and decider calls; the specified label cases determine the exact instruction and continuation labels, including the copy, shift, subtraction, comparison, and halving routines.
caveat: The declaration is a large explicit transition table; this concise description does not enumerate its individual label cases.
